- Jo has a severe peanut allergy and is concerned about allergen alerts and recalls for peanuts, allergen-containing products, frozen berries, and oat milk.  
- Jo’s toddler drinks oat milk daily, making recalls related to plant-based milks a priority.  
- Jo prefers short answers and a weekly email digest with updates on recalls.  
- Jo is advised to check Whole Foods first for recalls, with Safeway also being monitored.  
- Jo’s partner is lactose intolerant, so recalls related to lactose-free or dairy-free products will also be tracked.
